title: Small helicopter circles the crash site

tellings.quote: I think Ken was the first one to tell me about the helicopter. He said all of a sudden a very small helicopter showed up and kind of circled around the crash site, then took off to the northeast.

plain: After a craft is said to have crashed in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948, a very small helicopter reportedly showed up, circled the crash site, and then flew off to the northeast. Scott Ramsey, who has spent years looking into the Aztec crash, tells Michels he first heard about the helicopter from a local man named Ken Farley, and he also names Doug Noland as a source. If it happened, it would mean someone with aircraft reached the site soon after the crash.
